scope: Reviewed assertions and actual observed case execution. Coverage completeness, provider authentication, public signing and release approval remain independent review obligations.

scope_decisions.voiceover-excluded: Owner decision 2026-10-23: VoiceOver execution excluded; no spoken macOS accessibility claim.
scope_decisions.script-input-deferred: Owner decision 2026-10-24: Japanese/Chinese/Arabic-specific input/IME/shaping deferred; valid UTF-8 data/filenames remain unrestricted.
scope_decisions.windows-deferred: Owner decision 2026-10-21: Windows qualification deferred to a separate change; historical Windows evidence is not production support.
scope_decisions.isolated-adoption: In-place Go adoption is refused without lifetime exclusion. Supported route verifies an independent library/native profile/recovery clone; legacy authority stays source-directed.

final-candidate-and-independent-review.condition: Select exact final distributions, reconcile every mandatory subcase and independently approve the complete three-target clean/upgraded rehearsal before promotion.

public-mac-final-bytes.condition: Human-controlled Developer ID signing/notarization/stapling and independent installed final-byte verification on both matching Mac targets.
